title: Embassy Orb Manager DX
premise: Manage a playful roster of bouncing country-themed embassy orbs that generate credits over time while you expand routes, unlock rarer envoys, and build out a diplomatic archive.
interaction_model: Idle/clicker management with tap-to-collect bonuses, rotating shop purchases, roster deployment, map selection, and collection tracking through modal UI panels.
objective: Grow total credits by recruiting stronger envoy orbs, keeping valuable units deployed, unlocking boosted regions, and completing more of the national orb archive.
progression: Start with a single low-income orb, earn passive money every second, tap active orbs for tiny bonus credits, buy random weighted shop stock, manage active-vs-stored inventory, then unlock a premium route that boosts all income.
theme: Sci-fi embassy management mixed with humorous countryball-style national mascots and diplomatic route flavor.
mood: Playful, collectible, lighthearted, slightly futuristic, and cozy-incremental.
likely_audience: Players who enjoy simple idle progression, collection tracking, casual tapping, and whimsical nation-themed characters.
confidence_notes: High confidence this is primarily an idle/clicker management game.
High confidence the orb characters are countryball-inspired collectibles with passive-income roles.
Medium confidence on whether it should be framed as collector/gacha, because the rotating weighted shop creates rarity excitement without explicit loot-box pulls.
recreation_prompt: Create a mobile-friendly idle management game called "Embassy Orb Manager DX" where the playfield is a full-screen canvas filled with cute bouncing country-themed embassy orbs styled like glossy flag balls with cartoon eyes and occasional speech bubbles. The player starts with one cheap orb and earns credits automatically every second from each deployed orb, while also being able to tap any orb for a tiny instant bonus and a bounce reaction. Build the UI as a futuristic glassmorphism HUD with a credits counter, a shop restock timer, bottom navigation buttons for Market, Roster, Regions, and Archive, plus modal panels for each system. The Market should show a rotating stock of four envoy orbs rolled from weighted rarity chances, each with a purchase cost, rarity, and passive income per second. Buying an orb should either deploy it immediately or store it if the active roster is full. The Roster should let the player equip stored orbs and unequip active ones, enforcing a max active capacity. Include an Archive/Index that shows every possible country orb as collectible progression with locked and unlocked states. Add a Regions panel where the player can unlock and equip at least one premium route, such as a snow or polar route that grants a visible +15% income boost and changes the background art. Present the scene with soft sci-fi colors, animated floating reward text, subtle vibration/audio feedback, success and blocked-action overlays, auto-save, manual save, pause, and a lighthearted tone focused on passive growth, collecting rarer nation orbs, and steadily scaling income over repeated short play sessions.
